articles.description: A new United States intelligence report warns that China is developing energy weapons and spaceplanes that it could use for military operations in outer space, with the capability of using directed-energy weapons in orbit by the end of the 2020s. The US Defence Intelligence Agency (DIA) report, published on Sunday, includes a rare image of the newly developed reusable spaceplane. articles.title: Jackdaw Approval Sparks Fierce Debate Over Britain's Energy Future
articles.description: The United Kingdom approved the development of the Jackdaw North Sea gas field on the 21st of October following years of legal battles and political uncertainty. Jackdaw is a large offshore natural gas field in the North Sea, owned by Adura, a joint venture between Shell and Equinor, since 2025, located around 240 km east of Aberdeen in Scotland.
